# CAA transport envelope fixture

`caa-cloud-config.txt` was generated by the unmodified `CloudConfig.Generate`
implementation from cloud-api-adaptor
`e3e0f00480b41c08e3e4dbc6b64aba7722fb65f9`, at
`src/cloud-providers/util/cloudinit/cloudconfig.go`. Only the temporary Go
package declaration was changed to run its generator as a standalone program.
The input is a synthetic APF configuration with documentation-only IP ranges and
placeholder TLS values; no private key or deployment identity is included.

Rust tests replace those placeholders with non-cryptographic PEM envelopes to
test the transport decoder. APF itself must parse and match real TLS credentials
before listening; this fixture does not qualify APF networking, TLS or AWS boot.

The decoder deliberately recognizes the pinned producer's single-file envelope,
rather than interpreting arbitrary YAML/cloud-init directives. Producer format
changes must be reviewed with this fixture and the pinned CAA revision.
